finalists.label: Visceral Leishmaniasis
finalists.why: It has the most specific evidence, including massive splenomegaly and gross hepatosplenomegaly, despite the lack of travel history to leishmaniasis-endemic areas.

finalists.label: Infectious mononucleosis
finalists.why: It has specific evidence, including massive splenomegaly and elevated liver enzymes, with no findings against it.

frontier_selector.why: The evidence of massive splenomegaly and gross hepatosplenomegaly, along with low hemoglobin, decided the final comparison in favor of Visceral Leishmaniasis.
